contextSpeed.title: Move faster as the context fills
contextSpeed.description: The scene moves faster as the context fills, and shows its warning color from 80%: time to compact.

moveWhileWorking.title: Move only while Claude works
moveWhileWorking.description: The scene moves while Claude is working and rests while it waits for you. Off, it always moves.

coldCache.title: Cool down when the prompt cache goes cold
coldCache.description: The scene warns in the cache's last minute. Once it lapses, the scene stills and the app's colors cool, until your next message re-caches the context.

soundFollows.title: Sound follows the session
soundFollows.description: With the theme's sound on: it rests while Claude waits, rises with the context while it works, and falls quiet when the cache is cold. Off, it plays the same always.
